{{
  !Number.isInteger(Number(inpReadinessAssetId.text)) ||
  Number(inpReadinessAssetId.text) <= 0 ||
  !inpReadinessTenantCode.text.trim() ||
  !inpReadinessReason.text.trim() ||
  get_asset_readiness.data?.success !== true ||
  get_asset_readiness.data?.readiness?.asset?.asset_id !== Number(inpReadinessAssetId.text) ||
  get_asset_readiness.data?.readiness?.asset?.tenant_code !== inpReadinessTenantCode.text.trim() ||
  get_asset_readiness.data?.readiness?.asset_management_authorised !== true ||
  get_asset_readiness.data?.readiness?.execution_target_authorised === true
}}
